title: BluForge: AI-Powered Managed SOC & Cybersecurity Platform | Quadra
description: BluForge is Quadra's AI-powered cybersecurity platform offering 24/7 managed SOC operations, continuous threat intelligence, security architecture hardening, and rapid incident response for enterprises.

blocks.text: BluForge: AI-Powered Managed SOC & Cybersecurity Platform

Quadra BluForge™ unifies our expert-led managed SOC with a powerful AI-driven security platform. Built on the Microsoft Security ecosystem and designed for the multi-cloud enterprise, it delivers continuous visibility, intelligent correlation, and rapid response so you can operate with confidence.

We architect a paradigm shift in your security operations. BluForge™ is a modular suite of services designed to meet you where you are and take you where you need to be—from foundational monitoring to advanced threat hunting and incident response

Your fully managed 24/7 Security Operations Center. We provide real-time threat detection, triage, and management using our Microsoft-native platform and AI automation, giving you enterprise-grade vigilance without the overhead.

Our co-managed MXDR service designed to augment your existing team. We partner with your experts to provide advanced, human-led threat hunting, custom rule tuning, and shared incident response capabilities.

Your expert response team on immediate standby. This retainer service provides SLA-backed access to our top incident response and forensics experts to ensure rapid containment and remediation when a critical event occurs.
Our expert-led advisory and implementation service. We help you proactively enhance your security posture by architecting and deploying the full suite of modern security tools.
A track record of securing 100+ enterprises with rapid onboarding and a greater than 95% accuracy rate in alert triage
